protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. Before 3.2.2, AbstractPolicyOperator.normalizeOperator resolves each TYPE_POLICY_REF through PolicyRegistry, copies the resolved Policy's components into All, and recursively normalizes them without tracking active references. Registry policies A -> B and B -> A therefore recurse until StackOverflowError or hang. CVE.org currently records CVE-2026-42403 as PUBLISHED and affected < 3.2.2; Apache's security page recommends 3.2.2 or later.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed as 8baf24289b8a2976f7df94adac1d1470ec80be13. The earlier 1a8ffd6d39234d3e9615de52f818a78d113e8029 branch only looked up a PolicyReference and rejected an unresolved URI. Commit 8baf242 is the focused first write that adds All, copies the resolved policy components, and recursively calls normalizeOperator, creating the cycle-capable mechanism.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. Immediate parent 1dc43243631039e9f67f89ae0500178dd44e6fd1 is present and its TYPE_POLICY_REF branch ends after lookup/null rejection; it contains no recursive expansion of the referenced Policy. The parent-to-BIC diff adds exactly the three operative expansion/recursion lines plus whitespace.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed not applicable. The BIC has exactly one parent, changes only AbstractPolicyOperator.java, and is a four-added-line focused patch rather than a merge or aggregate squash; no finer public member commit is exposed. The later e174c261067c19e0fc8d26190da978d190214ed3 preserves the same recursion while changing its signature and adding #id lookup, so it is not the first-write BIC.
protocol_checks.affected_fixed_release_membership: Confirmed. The BIC is an ancestor of affected tag neethi-3.2.1. Direct fix 7a38f2be139d70fbf879fbb54eebe1fde633cc32 is not an ancestor of neethi-3.2.1 and is an ancestor of neethi-3.2.2; tag containment begins at neethi-3.2.2 (also neethi-3.2.3), matching the authoritative < 3.2.2 boundary.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix 7a38f2be139d70fbf879fbb54eebe1fde633cc32. It passes a Set<String> through recursive normalization, rejects a repeated resolved policy id with 'Circular PolicyReference detected', removes ids after unwinding, and adds an A <-> B PolicyReference regression test. This directly blocks the advisory's id-bearing circular-reference mechanism.

The 2007 commit object names human Apache author and committer Hettige Don Ignatious Nywan Sanka Samaranayake <sanka@apache.org>; its short message has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI marker. Fix authorship and unrelated repository AI-marked commits were not used for attribution.
